_comment: Each module's maturity, defined once (`option`: its option's key, when not <module>_enabled; "" for none of its own). The admin page reads it; tools/maturity.py --update writes it into the app's option descriptions and the docs (a test fails when they differ).

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.meaning: Started, but it doesn't do its job yet. Leave it off.

development.name: In development
development.meaning: Being built: parts work, it changes often, and an update may break it. For the curious.

alpha.name: Alpha
alpha.meaning: Does its job every day in the author's house, but hasn't been tried in many others. Expect rough edges and changes.

beta.name: Beta
beta.meaning: Complete and used every day; its features have settled. Please report what breaks in your setup.

released.name: Released
released.meaning: Settled and dependable. Changes are announced, and existing setups keep working.
